shots.name: repair-succeeds

actions.eval: (()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>/Used tools \d+ times/.test(x.textContent||'')); if (b) b.click(); return true;})()

shots.expect: js:(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-block]')]; return b.length>=1 && b.some(x=>x.dataset.planStatus==='proposed') && document.body.innerText.includes('Review the auth module before the release');})()

shots.name: repair-also-fails

actions.eval: (()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>/Used tools \d+ times/.test(x.textContent||'')); if (b) b.click(); return true;})()

shots.expect: js:(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-block]')]; return b.length>=1 && b.every(x=>x.dataset.planStatus==='failed') && document.body.innerText.includes("The assistant's plan wasn't in a form the app can use.");})()

shots.name: proposed-then-messages
shots.expect: js:(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-block]')]; return b.length===1 && b[0].dataset.planStatus==='proposed' && document.body.innerText.includes('does this touch the database at all?');})()

shots.name: running-then-messages
shots.expect: js:(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-block]')]; return b.length===1 && b[0].dataset.planStatus==='running' && document.body.innerText.includes('does this touch the database at all?');})()
